answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 23341 Country: Bangladesh Title: 1. what is the benefit to pray before sunrise for women on the basis of Islam ? If any woman prays after sunrise of own accord what is the adversity according to the Quran & Hadith? 2. Is the presence of witness essential during nikah ? Nikah will be valid only presence of Allah,is it true? Question: 1. what is the benefit to pray before sunrise for women on the basis of Islam ? If any woman prays after sunrise of own accord what is the adversity according to the Quran & Hadith? 2. Is the presence of witness essential during nikah ? Nikah will be valid only presence of Allah,is it true? Answer ID: 23341 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 994/786/D=1431) (1) Dua can be made any, time there is no harm. However, in some particular time making dua and offering nafl salah has more virtue and it brings more reward. The best time is that of tahajjud. Sitting at the same place after Fajr salah till the sun rises high and getting oneself involved in dua and tashbih is also one of the best acts. (2) Yes, the nikah is not valid without the presence of witnesses. At least two Muslim witnesses should witness the event and hear the ijab and qubul (formal exchange of words) that solemnize the nikah. (3) No, (nikah will not be valid by only making Allah witness). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
